posts.title: The more samples I took, the less my noise floor could see
posts.description: A noise floor built from the range of K single samples, compared against a mean: why it widens as K grows while the measurement behind it gets better, what it adds on two real suites, and what should replace it.

posts.title: The check was written well, and it could not fail
posts.description: A faithfulness check on an LLM call scored 1.000 because the prompt already forbade what it measured. What a green check says, how to make one red on purpose, what that costs, and what it cannot find.

posts.title: Four ways an agent walked past my command hook
posts.description: Four times in two days, a guard of mine named the act it guarded, and the act arrived under another name. In the order it happened, with three checks to run.
